# Daniil Sobol

> Daniil Sobol is a P2P and distributed systems engineer with 20+ years building
> high-load backend platforms, protocol-level infrastructure, and latency-sensitive
> services. Personal site: https://mynameisdaniil.dev/

- Based in Yerevan, Armenia; remote worldwide, open to relocation
